summary: Iteration 22 - Testing Brand/Center CRUD and Logo Upload features. All 17 backend tests passed. All UI features verified working via Playwright including Marcas/Centros panel, Nueva Marca dialog with URL/Upload toggle, and Edit functionality.
passed_tests: GET /api/brand-statistics/brands - returns list of 7 brands with logos
POST /api/brand-statistics/brands - creates new brand successfully
POST /api/brand-statistics/brands - duplicate ID returns 400
PUT /api/brand-statistics/brands/{id} - updates brand name, color, logo
PUT /api/brand-statistics/brands/{id} - nonexistent returns 404
DELETE /api/brand-statistics/brands/{id} - soft deletes brand (sets active=false)
DELETE /api/brand-statistics/brands/{id} - nonexistent returns 404
GET /api/brand-statistics/centers - returns list of 7 centers (Canary Islands)
POST /api/brand-statistics/centers - creates new center with island/address
POST /api/brand-statistics/centers - creates center with brand association
DELETE /api/brand-statistics/centers/{id} - soft deletes center
POST /api/upload - requires authentication (returns 401/403)
POST /api/upload - uploads image and returns URL
POST /api/upload - invalid file type returns 400
POST /api/upload - accepts jpg, png, gif, webp formats
GET /api/brand-statistics/brands - accessible to authenticated users
POST /api/brand-statistics/brands - admin can create brands
UI: Marcas/Centros tab displays brand cards with logos and colors
UI: Nueva Marca dialog has URL and Subir archivo toggle
UI: File upload mode shows Seleccionar imagen button
UI: Centros tab shows 7 Canary Island centers
UI: Edit button opens edit dialog for brands
critical_code_review_comments: Brand CRUD properly implements soft delete (sets active=false)
Upload endpoint correctly validates file types and size (max 5MB)
Frontend BrandCenterManager.jsx properly handles both URL and file upload modes
Logo upload constructs full URL from baseURL + response.url for storage
All brands display with proper color indicators and logos in UI
seed_data_creation: Default brands and centers are auto-seeded when collections are empty
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 verified Brand/Center CRUD and Logo Upload features: (1) Backend CRUD for brands: GET list, POST create, PUT update, DELETE soft-delete with validation. (2) Backend CRUD for centers: GET list, POST create with island/brand association, DELETE soft-delete. (3) Upload endpoint at POST /api/upload accepting jpg, png, gif, webp, svg up to 5MB. (4) Frontend BrandCenterManager.jsx at Marcas/Centros tab showing 7 default brands (AUDI, VOLKSWAGEN, SKODA, HONDA, DUCATI, DAOCASION, Ocasión Domingo Alonso) and 7 Canary Island centers. (5) Nueva Marca dialog has URL/Subir archivo toggle for logo input.
